name: SCU Resilience Merit Scholarship
summary: $36,000 for school leavers with an ATAR of 80 or more who faced financial or educational barriers, starting full-time at SCU.
who: Starting any full-time bachelor degree at SCU in Term 1.
Faced financial and/or educational barriers, shown through an SCU Equity Scholarship application, Inclusion Support registration or hardship questions.
how: Selection uses your ATAR and your equity, inclusion or scholarship application answers.
catches: Not for students who already get another SCU-funded scholarship.

source.label: Southern Cross University: Resilience Merit Scholarship

evidence.quote: Have achieved a minimum ATAR (IB Diploma score equivalent) of 80 and above.
Be commencing any full-time Bachelor's degree at Southern Cross University in Term 1.
